name: yue_speech_benchmark_fixed
description: A fixed benchmark of Yue (Cantonese) speech data evaluating automatic speech recognition performance for the Yue language. It measures ASR accuracy under realistic variations in speech (dialect, speaker, noise) and is intended to benchmark models' transcription quality.
reputation: A focused regional ASR benchmark of interest to researchers working on Cantonese ASR; adoption is modest and primarily regional.
